label: Annual revenue
definition: The income produced by a system in one year.
comment: It is usually the energy sold times the tariff.

label: Benefit-cost ratio
definition: The ratio of the discounted benefits to the discounted costs of a project.
comment: A value above 1 indicates a profitable project.

label: Capital cost
definition: The initial investment needed to build a system.
comment: It is often given per unit of installed capacity, for example in USD/kW.

label: Certified emission reductions
definition: The emission reductions of a project certified for carbon markets.
comment: They are counted in tonnes of CO2-equivalent per year.

label: Cost of energy (COE)
definition: The cost of producing one unit of energy, usually computed from the present value of costs divided by the energy produced.
comment: In many wind studies it is computed with the present value of costs method; it is close to, but not always discounted like, the LCOE.

label: Cost of water
definition: The cost of supplying one cubic metre of water.
comment: It is used for water-pumping and desalination systems.

label: Electricity tariff
definition: The price paid per unit of electricity sold or bought.
comment: It includes feed-in tariffs and retail prices.

label: Internal rate of return (IRR)
definition: The discount rate at which the net present value of a project is zero.
comment: It is given in percent and compared with the cost of capital.

label: Levelised cost of electricity (LCOE)
definition: The ratio of the discounted lifetime costs of a power plant to the discounted lifetime electricity it produces.
comment: It is given in currency per kWh or MWh and allows plants of different sizes and lifetimes to be compared.

label: Net present cost (NPC)
definition: The sum of the discounted costs of a system over its lifetime minus the discounted revenues.
comment: It is the main output of HOMER optimisations.

label: Net present value (NPV)
definition: The sum of the discounted cash flows of a project over its lifetime.
comment: A positive value indicates a profitable project at the chosen discount rate.

label: Operation and maintenance cost
definition: The recurring cost of operating and maintaining a system.
comment: It is often given per year or as a percentage of the capital cost.

label: Payback period
definition: The time needed for the cumulative revenues or savings of a project to equal its investment.
comment: It is given in years; the simple payback period ignores discounting.
